Target company: Microsoft (MSFT). Microsoft develops software and cloud services including Windows, Microsoft 365 and Azure, and operates gaming, business-software and related technology businesses.

Focal announcement: Announcing Microsoft Copilot, your everyday AI companion.

Decision cutoff: 2023-09-21T23:59:59-04:00. Use only information available before this cutoff.

Source: Announcing Microsoft Copilot, your everyday AI companion. Published date: 2023-09-21. URL: https://blogs.microsoft.com/blog/2023/09/21/announcing-microsoft-copilot-your-everyday-ai-companion.

Condensed source passage, selected from the supplied excerpt; other details are omitted: Updated November 15, 2023: To simplify the user experience and make Copilot more accessible to everyone, Bing Chat and Bing Chat Enterprise will now simply become Microsoft Copilot. Copilot will begin to roll out in its early form as part of our free update to Windows 11, starting Sept. 26 — and across Bing, Edge, and Microsoft 365 Copilot this fall. Microsoft 365 Copilot will be generally available for enterprise customers on Nov. 1, 2023, along with Microsoft 365 Chat, a new AI assistant that will completely transform the way you work. In March, we showed you what Microsoft 365 Copilot can do in the apps millions of people use every day across work and life – Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and Teams – using just your own words. After months of learning alongside customers like Visa, General Motors, KPMG and Lumen Technologies, we’re excited to share that Microsoft 365 Copilot will be generally available for enterprise customers on Nov. 1.
